name: Product Delivery Obligation
definition: Obligation for the seller  to deliver goods or services to the buyer.

ProductDeliveryOffset.name: Product Delivery Offset
ProductDeliveryOffset.definition: Fulfilment of a product delivery obligation through the delivery of goods and services. It is derived from the association between Obligation and Obligation fulfillment.

CommercialTrade.name: Commercial Trade
CommercialTrade.definition: Specifies the trade which originates the obligation to deliver a specific product.
